description: OpenInfra active travel tools inventory provides a curated inventory of open-access transport research data, tools, modelling and simulation resources. The provider is University of Leeds Urban Data Science group (udsleeds). Geographical and temporal coverage: The inventory is an information source with examples from multiple places; it is not a geographically complete transport dataset. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. Licence: MIT, read from the repository's licence file on 2026-09-27; obtaining it is free of charge. Caveats: Links describe external resources whose availability and licences must be checked separately. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. It is conceptually related to model-sumo, model-matsim, which supplies a comparison or modelling context; compatibility is not asserted.
